customerOutcome: Inspect the recorded native run and exact historical revision without exposing private payloads or treating recorded completion as independent verification.
entryConditions: Current authenticated principal and company selection; no retained foreign-principal payload
Effective feature admission is required for new work; native membership and resource authority remain necessary
exitConditions: Only a canonical server-confirmed result permits a success claim
Pending, stale, unavailable or unqualified work never becomes successful or activated

content.supportingCopy: Inspect the recorded native run and exact historical revision without exposing private payloads or treating recorded completion as independent verification.
displayedState: Exact native run/revision IDs and revision number/state; superseded versions are never labeled current active
Recorded attempt status, attempt number, registry operation and agent/tool execution presence only
Current native wait kinds on waiting attempts; declared approval checkpoint is not an approval decision
Private inputs, outputs, errors, actor IDs and hidden reasoning are omitted
Oversized, duplicate or unbound history is unavailable; no attempt history is distinct from successful execution

primary.label: Refresh run
primary.operation: Re-read current native run admission and attempt metadata. No execution, cancellation, retry or approval is performed.

secondary: Open native run controls in Advanced

canonicalReadDomains: Native workflow executor run/payload access and learned-asset analytical-source admission
Exact native historical workflow revision and immutable node registry descriptors
Current human identity, company membership and workflows:read
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: None; native executor and existing revision owner retain all state and effects.
systemWork.authorityEffect: Presentation and drafts cannot grant permissions. Material effects always require current native permissions, approvals and version preconditions.
systemWork.asyncWork: Native privacy-checked run and exact revision reads. Projection bounds: 100 nodes, 200 graph edges, 500 attempts and 200 waits. Native read-owner database latency and payload checks remain inherited.
systemWork.receipt: Only the exact native run/revision identity and recorded state. No independent verification, approval, safe retry, test qualification or current-active receipt is invented.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: No recorded step attempts; not a successful or verified result.
states.partial: Whole trace unavailable for oversized, duplicate, foreign or unbound history; no silent truncation.
states.stale: Hide retained private data during background rechecks and live authority/privacy/version invalidations; a new query epoch rejects late prior responses.
states.validation_error: This read-only surface accepts no workflow inputs.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect.
states.success: Native recorded completion is distinct from independently verified external outcomes.

navigation.back: Return to the native workflow run list.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: No writes or browser-persisted inputs. Leave through Run history; native Advanced controls retain canonical authority.
navigation.resume: Re-read current company/principal/run/revision bindings and native privacy/grants. Shell rollback restores native run controls; /advanced retains a direct native route.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Native run/revision identity and recorded status
Allowlisted attempt metadata and current waiting kinds
sensitiveFields: Run/step inputs, outputs, errors, credentials, actor assignments, approval resolutions, reference IDs, wait tokens and hidden reasoning remain excluded
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Purpose-separated workflow-run-experience namespace for success and rejected requests; generic logs omit account query strings, raw errors and private payloads.

functional: Verify exact historical revision, native attempts, retry numbers, wait association, no mutations and empty/unavailable separation.
Complete selected-agent/tool identity, independently verified outcome/error and branch-path reconstruction remain open; this metadata view does not fulfill all §81.9 requirements.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current native grants/membership, account/company/agent denial, private-value exclusion, no-store, rejected-request log minimization and late-response suppression.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
